news.title: Infosys ADRs fall over 4% as Q1 revenue guidance cut overshadows profit growth
news.summary: Infosys ADRs fell over 4% after the IT major trimmed the upper end of its FY27 revenue growth guidance despite reporting higher June-quarter profit and revenue. Investors remained concerned over weak discretionary demand, slower constant currency growth and cautious client technology spending.

Analysts warned of inflation risks, weaker market momentum and continued volatility, with Nifty facing resistance near the 24,000 level.

news.title: Infosys Q1 Results: Attrition rate improves to 13%; headcount slips sequentially
news.summary: Infosys reported its Q1 FY27 earnings, with a voluntary attrition rate of 13%, down from 14.4% year-on-year. The workforce decreased by 532 employees sequentially to 328,062, but saw a year-on-year increase of 4,274 employees compared to June 2024.
